title: Curated Research Telemetry Dataset
purpose: Validated and curated synthetic temperature observation dataset produced by the Lab 2 deterministic curation pipeline.

columns.name: record_id
columns.meaning: Unique logical identifier of the observation record.

columns.name: sensor_id
columns.meaning: Identifier of the sensor that produced the observation.

columns.name: site
columns.meaning: Site associated with the sensor according to the sensor registry.

columns.name: event_time_utc
columns.meaning: UTC timestamp when the observation event occurred.

columns.name: ingest_time_utc
columns.meaning: UTC timestamp when the observation was ingested.

columns.name: temperature_c
columns.meaning: Validated temperature measurement in degrees Celsius.

columns.name: is_late
columns.meaning: Indicates whether the valid observation arrived later than the configured timeliness threshold.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: Original source object from which the observation originated.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number of the observation within the original source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object used for provenance verification.
